facts.fact: A 2026 eMarketer survey found that 5 in 10 US decision-makers measure only what is easy, expected, or visible.
facts.quote: found that 5 in 10 US decision-makers only measure “what’s easy, expected, or visible,”

facts.fact: The same 2026 eMarketer survey found that 78% of respondents believe up to 10% of media spend is wasted due to insufficient measurement methods.
facts.quote: 78% believing that up to 10% of media spend is wasted due to insufficient measurement methods

facts.fact: In 2025, 47% of US brand and agency marketers said marketing attribution and measurement were their top investment priorities, according to eMarketer.
facts.quote: 47% of US brand and agency marketers

facts.fact: In an in-platform analysis of about 5M StackAdapt-influenced conversion paths from January to March of 2026, 52.5% of conversion journeys spanned multiple channels.
facts.quote: 52.5% of conversion journeys span multiple channels.

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's in-platform analysis of about 5M influenced conversion paths from January to March 2026, 1 in 4 conversions relied on cross-channel sequencing to drive results.
facts.quote: 1 in 4 conversions rely on cross-channel sequencing to drive results.

facts.fact: According to eMarketer, over 20% of US advertisers adjust their ad budgets at least twice a month based on measurement data.
facts.quote: over 20% of US advertisers adjust their ad budgets at least twice a month based on measurement data.

facts.fact: According to a Branch report cited by StackAdapt (The 2025 State of App Growth), 41% of mobile growth, marketing, and product leaders worldwide say privacy measures online are leading to difficulties with cross-channel attribution.
facts.quote: 41% of mobile growth, marketing, and product leaders worldwide saying privacy measures online are leading to difficulties with cross-channel attribution

facts.fact: According to the IAB's State of Data 2026 report cited by StackAdapt, up to 75% of US buy-side leaders say core ad measurement approaches, including attribution analysis, incrementality tests, and MMM, underperform.
facts.quote: up to 75% of US buy-side leaders say core ad measurement approaches—including attribution analysis, incrementality tests, and MMM—underperform
